School Info & Login
Backup

The app keeps automatic backups of the whole database (students, attendance, fees, receipts, expenses and everything else) as a single .alasif file.

Last backup-
Backups kept7 max
Data istemal-
FolderAlAsifBackups

Auto-backup runs once a day and after every 50 changes.

CSV backup

The whole database as CSV files (one file per table) inside a zip. Unzip it to open any table in Excel. Urdu text Excel mein sahi dikhta hai.

Import: .zip (is HTML se bana hua) ya aik .csv file (students.csv). Headers check hote hain, phir data replace hota hai. APK/Flutter format wali CSV se APK aur software ke beech students + classes exchange hote hain.
